findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: v2GetFuturesForSport, v2GetAffiliates, v2GetHedgeOpportunityByID, v2GetParlayBook, v2GetBestParlayBook, capture_v1_stream, capture_market_stream, capture_live_stream, capture_hedge_stream · Private data: v2GetStatsSample, v2GetFuturesEventByID · Public sink: v2GetParlayBook, v2GetBestParlayBook · Destructive: v1GetDelta, v1GetDeltaV2.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: v2GetFuturesForSport, v2GetAffiliates, v2GetHedgeOpportunityByID, v2GetParlayBook, v2GetBestParlayBook, capture_v1_stream, capture_market_stream, capture_live_stream, capture_hedge_stream · Private data: v2GetStatsSample, v2GetFuturesEventByID · Public sink: v2GetParlayBook, v2GetBestParlayBook · Destructive: v1GetDelta, v1GetDeltaV2

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
